Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes This PR removes immediate verification of successful private update writes while retaining recovery-input checks and operation-error handling. **Example:** An update fails verification and restores the retained 1.0.0 package. - **Before:** Rollback checks the retained package, restores it, then scans the restored tree again. - **After:** Rollback checks the retained package and trusts successful restoration, while restore errors still prevent certification. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | The patch is focused and has no identified correctness defect, but supplied validation does not satisfy the repository's installed update and recovery proof requirement; schemas and serialized formats are unchanged. | | **Proof confidence** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | Real behavior proof is not required for maintainer- or bot-authored pull requests. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Refactor · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Updates repeat filesystem scans and journal reads after successful operations have already established their results. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction explicitly accepts the narrow private-output tradeoff, reduces redundant work and preserves incident-backed safeguards. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep open: this maintainer-authored PR makes a coherent simplification with explicitly accepted tradeoffs, and source review found no actionable correctness defect. **Priority:** P3 **Reviewed head:** `a093c8085b43a3158c8d27697696707910f254a6` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None. ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: Supply an installed latest-stable-to-candidate upgrade and candidate-driver rollback/recovery run showing intact settings and data, working launchers and restart, with sensitive values redacted.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The package updater prepares candidate packages and plugins, journals publication, and restores retained packages and launchers after failure; its results determine whether recovery and restart are safe. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Update command] --> B[Candidate preparation] B --> C[Package swap owner] C --> D[Activation journal] C --> E[Filesystem operations] E --> F[Retained recovery checks] F --> G[Recovery result] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Retain this focused removal of redundant reads while preserving the existing integrity, authority, durability and recovery owners. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? This is a refactor rather than a reported bug; source inspection confirms the duplicate reads, and the body reports reduced restored-root lstat work in a production-owner fixture. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The change follows existing ownership boundaries, removes superseded callers and helpers, and preserves real operation failures; no additional architecture is needed. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [15c4064f72d8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/15c4064f72d8934f75429dbea75713ae135bf9a8). ### Provenance checked - `Retained and restored package verification` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (000af986dc991e9cef3d10663c121503606f25cc: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/140339 retained compatible rollback and safe recovery admission; restored-tree verification also traces to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/136329.) - `Private launcher copy comparison` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (83d73f3fbf1dd2bece75c853163c57ca33312b52: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/153081 distinguished real launcher-copy mismatches from unsupported metadata; this PR explicitly retires immediate output comparison while retaining metadata preservation and retained-backup checks.) - `Journal creation and transition rereads` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (b107d4af14d7d3d190fd8310c41b95142a5414c5: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/158491 introduced durable interrupted-update recovery; transition code was subsequently shared by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167660.) - `Disposable plugin copy output hash` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (a2e44be9f830e0c63f5904a50f1956b43aa0114c: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166317 introduced bounded worker copying with source fingerprints and output hashes; this PR deliberately removes only the immediate destination hash.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Pinned introduced change:** The introduced diff removes output rereads and their obsolete helpers and tests; fetched main retains the original production behavior. ([`src/infra/package-update-swap.ts:125`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/a093c8085b43a3158c8d27697696707910f254a6/src/infra/package-update-swap.ts#L125), [a093c8085b43](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a093c8085b43a3158c8d27697696707910f254a6)) - **Restore failures remain unverified:** Retained-input refusal and restore-operation errors clear packageRollbackVerified; external Git runtime verification and partial native-backup inspection remain. ([`src/infra/package-update-swap.ts:153`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/a093c8085b43a3158c8d27697696707910f254a6/src/infra/package-update-swap.ts#L153), [a093c8085b43](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a093c8085b43a3158c8d27697696707910f254a6)) - **Committed journal facts:** Transitions retain authoritative preimage comparison, revision-qualified UPDATE, identity checks and live authority at COMMIT; the transaction owner returns the prepared result only after successful commit. ([`src/infra/package-update-activation-journal.ts:317`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/a093c8085b43a3158c8d27697696707910f254a6/src/infra/package-update-activation-journal.ts#L317), [a093c8085b43](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a093c8085b43a3158c8d27697696707910f254a6)) - **Accepted tradeoffs and supplied validation:** The maintainer-authored body explicitly accepts successful private-output corruption checks becoming best effort, reports focused tests and a retained rollback fixture, and supplies no installed upgrade or recovery run. ([a093c8085b43](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a093c8085b43a3158c8d27697696707910f254a6)) - **Human incident safeguards preserved:** The symlink metadata repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/153081 remains in the copy owner, and the OverlayFS fallback from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164769 remains outside the removed checks. ([`src/infra/package-update-filesystem.ts:264`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/a093c8085b43a3158c8d27697696707910f254a6/src/infra/package-update-filesystem.ts#L264), [a093c8085b43](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a093c8085b43a3158c8d27697696707910f254a6)) - **Repository policy applied:** Read the complete root AGENTS.md; no src or src/infra ancestor AGENTS.md or maintainer-notes directory exists. The update contract requires published-driver and candidate proof: https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating. ([`docs/install/updating.md:41`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating), [a093c8085b43](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a093c8085b43a3158c8d27697696707910f254a6)) Likely related people: - **Peter Steinberger:** Raw commit b107d4af14d7d3d190fd8310c41b95142a5414c5 adds src/infra/package-update-activation-journal.ts:259 relative to its recorded parents. This identifies author metadata, not feature responsibility or a PR merger. (role: source-line author; confidence: high; commits: [b107d4af14d7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b107d4af14d7d3d190fd8310c41b95142a5414c5); files: `src/infra/package-update-activation-journal.ts`) ### PR surface Source -103, Tests -69. ### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **Production versus test LOC** | Production +35/-138; tests +0/-69 | The reduction removes immediate output verification, its unused helper and tests specific to the explicitly retired guarantees. | ### Labels Label changes: - add `P3`: This is an internal simplification with no claimed user-visible behavior or latency change. - add `rating: 🧂 unranked krab`: Overall readiness is 🧂 unranked krab; proof is 🧂 unranked krab and patch quality is 🐚 platinum hermit. - add `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`: ClawSweeper has no concrete contributor-facing blocker left for this PR.
